title: Crystalline Silicon Terrestrial Photovoltaic (PV) Modules — Design Qualification and Type Approval (Second Revision)
scope: Specifies requirements for the design qualification and type approval of terrestrial crystalline silicon photovoltaic modules suitable for long-term operation in open-air climates.
qco_reference: Solar Photovoltaics, Systems, Devices and Components Goods (Requirements for Compulsory Registration) Order, 2021 (S.O. 3811(E))

clauses.title: Visual Inspection
clauses.content: No cracked, broken, or misaligned cells, faulty interconnects, or bubbling in encapsulation.

clauses.title: Maximum Power Determination
clauses.content: Power output shall be determined under Standard Test Conditions (STC: 1000 W/m2, 25 deg C cell temp, AM 1.5 spectrum).

clauses.title: Insulation Test
clauses.content: The module shall withstand a test voltage of 2000 V plus 4 times the maximum system voltage applied between the output terminals and the frame.
